task.description: Re-review test coverage after ELIXIR-DEV's rework (commits 9a7f95f/e6280fd) addressing RELEASE-VALIDATOR's Step 5 FAIL on AC5: the shipped test previously only asserted 8 expected keys' presence plus 3 named exclusions, never the full key set. Confirm the added full-key-set assertions genuinely close the gap and nothing else regressed.
acceptance_criteria: AC5: response allowlist -- full key-set assertion (Map.keys sorted equality), not just presence/exclusion checks, at every response site built from user_map/1

result.summary:
Confirmed branch feature/WF02-REQ073-20260822 at commit e6280fd (git branch --show-current, git log -5).

1. Read lib/letflow/routers/identity.ex's user_map/1 (lines 322-333) directly: exactly 8 hand-built keys -- id, username, display_name, email, status, auth_source, inserted_at, updated_at. Confirmed myself, not trusted from any prior claim.

2. Read test/letflow/routers/identity_test.exs in full (510 lines). Confirmed all 5 places carry a genuine full-key-set assertion (`Map.keys(...) |> Enum.sort() == [8 literal keys, alphabetically sorted]`), each matching user_map/1's actual key set exactly -- not a subset check disguised as one:
   - create response, lines 110-119
   - list-per-item response (looped over every item), lines 142-151
   - get response, lines 168-177
   - patch response, lines 195-204
   - status-update response, lines 224-233
   All five lists are identical and alphabetically sorted: ["auth_source", "display_name", "email", "id", "inserted_at", "status", "updated_at", "username"] -- matches user_map/1's key set with no omission or addition.

3. Re-ran myself: `mix test test/letflow/routers/identity_test.exs` -> Result: 23 passed, 0 failures. Matches the rework's claimed 23/23 exactly, independently reproduced.

4. Re-mapped all 6 ACs against the now-fixed file (AC1-AC4, AC6 unchanged from my prior PASS at step-03b; re-confirmed no incidental changes crept in elsewhere in the diff -- `git show 9a7f95f --stat` and `git show e6280fd --stat` touch only the test file and a handoff-record file respectively, no production code changed by the rework). AC5 now genuinely closed: full key-set equality is asserted at every response site derived from user_map/1, so a stray 9th key under any other name would be caught at all five sites, not just the one RELEASE-VALIDATOR flagged.

5. Independent mutation check (not skipped, given this exact property was the one missed before): temporarily added a 9th key (`"stray_mutant_field" => "should be caught"`) to user_map/1 in lib/letflow/routers/identity.ex. Re-ran `mix test test/letflow/routers/identity_test.exs` -> Result: 18/23 passed, 5 failed -- exactly the 5 tests carrying the new full-key-set assertion (create, list-item, get, patch, status-update), each failing on the Map.keys equality as expected. Confirms the fix actually discriminates a stray field, not merely asserts something cosmetic. Reverted with `git checkout -- lib/letflow/routers/identity.ex` immediately after. Verified revert: `git status --porcelain lib/ test/` -> empty (no output), and grep for the mutant string in the file returns no match. Re-ran the suite post-revert: `mix test test/letflow/routers/identity_test.exs` -> Result: 23 passed, confirming clean revert to green.

No other gaps found: no `@tag :skip`, no 'TODO: implement test' anywhere in the file. Fixtures remain self-sufficient (unique tenant slug_prefix/UUID-based schema and username/email per test, no shared hardcoded state, no test depends on another having run first). No hardcoded secrets/connection strings.

AC5 is genuinely closed by this rework. All checks pass -- PASS.

test_run_evidence.mutation_probe: added a 9th key (stray_mutant_field) to user_map/1 in lib/letflow/routers/identity.ex -- 5 of 23 tests failed (exactly the 5 full-key-set assertion sites), reverted via git checkout, git status --porcelain confirmed empty, re-run confirmed 23 passed again

result.next_action: Route to TEST-RUNNER (Step 4) and RELEASE-VALIDATOR (Step 5) to re-confirm the full suite and re-derive all 6 ACs, then to DOC-UPDATER once green.
